text:
katie: Quick heads-up from Acme sync  they want SSO + full audit trail in our MVP and they're asking to move up the pilot to end-of-quarter.

marco: That's a hard pivot. SSO core + OIDC passthrough is reasonable; full audit trail (export/retention/queries) is a 2-3 week lift.

tess: Can we offer a phased pledge: MVP = SSO core + webhook-style minimal events; v1 = full searchable audit logs? That keeps the milestone intact.

ben: Tech sketch:
```
MVP-phased: SSO core, minimal event stream -> no long-term retention, no export
MVP-full: SSO + audit index + 30d retention + export API -> +3w infra + compliance
```

marco: Cost estimate for MVP-full: ~+$8k/mo infra + 0.5 FTE for 3 weeks to get compliance signoff.

katie: Sales says Acme conditions auditability for pilot contract. They might sign LOI if we commit to MVP-full. Need timeline impact before promising.

release-bot: Note: upcoming auth-service canary 2025-10-02 02:00 UTC  coordinate feature flags.

tess: Action: @ben to post two cutlists (phased vs full) with delta time/cost/risk by EOD. @katie to confirm if LOI is firm. Reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
